body:
Tuesday: the pasture-test workers slept here with gray foam on their boots. The creek tasted bitter, and the grass along it had gone pale where they rinsed their tanks.

I wrote down which pasture rows had browned while I could still remember them.

There may be a simple reason for the change. Nobody I asked knew what the foam was.
title: Diary page

body: We stayed under this roof because the trail below was listed as an evacuation route. A runner came back saying the gate at its end had been chained before noon. I left a dry blanket here for whoever believed the same sign.
title: Notebook page
